Name: FS - Lighter Default Hair Mask
Author: blkmmb
Description:
I am replacing the default hairstyles with a lighter mask version to help have more accurate colors and brighter overall colors. There is no other modifications and I tried to affect the overall shading the least. This should allow hair colors like blonde to be more possible than default. It is made for Fashion Sense.
